text:
alex.m: Quick sync — I'm drafting an "onboarding exit criteria" checklist for the model catalog + a customer canary program. Want to align on what must be satisfied before a model is listed and what we can offer customers in canaries. Short thoughts below, reactions welcome.

tara.p: +1 to having a strict exit checklist. one ask: do NOT default to pinning for orgs. prefer opt-in pin with a clear TTL.

jing.w: Proposed 3 buckets for exit criteria: infra, perf/quality, and comms/docs. rough thresholds to discuss: 
```
- infra: serving replicas >=2 in target region, KV cache warmup verified
- perf: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 900ms on supported sequence lengths
- quality: eval suite pass >= 94% on critical prompt set (regression delta < 1.5%)
- security: data residency + KMS verified
- docs: migration notes, fallback mapping, and sample prompts
```

samir.k: For customer canaries: incentivize with credit + 2-week priority support + migration assistance. require opt-in and a rollback SLA (48h rollback window after canary flag flip). also: need legal ok for early customer metrics collection.

product-bot: Created PL-9876: "model-catalog-onboarding-checklist" and assigned to @jing.w, @tara.p, @samir.k. Link: https://phab.internal/PL-9876

ops-oncall: Ops notes: limit canary exposure to 5-15% of org traffic, feature-flag gated, and include an immediate kill switch. We'll need a short runbook snippet in the checklist: `ops-mode: canary | full`, `kill-switch: /api/admin/fallback/<model>`

alex.m: A couple of open questions: 
- pinning: default unpinned, but allow org-scoped pin that persists for X days? suggested flow: customer requests pin -> we grant pin with TTL 90d -> renewal opt-in.
- rollforward: if a canary fails QA, do we auto-fallback to previous verified model or keep canary paused? my preference: auto-fallback + incident ticket created.

tara.p: Agree on TTL approach. UX note: expose pin expiry in console + email 7d before expiration. for orgs with compliance needs we should surface a "sticky pin" request that goes through sales/legal.

jing.w: I'll draft the checklist and a minimal CI job that runs the perf/quality gates (nightly eval). will include a `pin_review` label and a small sample playbook for rollbacks.

samir.k: I'll draft the canary incentives doc and the customer comms template. also confirm with legal on metrics collection.

ops-oncall: We'll add the canary runbook + kill switch steps to the infra repo. Also request: add metric alerts for regression delta and p99 jumps.

alex.m: Nice. Action items: 
- jing.w -> checklist + CI job (due EOD next Tue)
- tara.p -> pin UX copy + TTL options (due end of week)
- samir.k -> incentives + comms + legal check (due next Wed)
- ops-oncall -> runbook + feature flag implementation notes (due next Tue)

alex.m: Can we aim to pilot with 2 customer canaries in Q3? :thumbsup:

tara.p: :thumbsup:

jing.w: sounds good

samir.k: yes, will prep asks for sales/CS

product-bot: Updated PL-9876 with sub-tasks and owners.

alex.m: Thanks everyone — will consolidate into a short PR for the onboarding doc and add to the product roadmap board. If you have blockers reply here or ping me.
